subject: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of the pilot so far
- Pilot window: 6/1 — 6/21 (current)
- Observed burn: ~1.2M tokens over the past 7 days; projected burn if usage holds ~4.8M tokens/month
- Primary flows: chat summarization (60%), embedding lookups (25%), reranking (15%)

Pricing/qualification notes (from your team)
- Target unit economics: $/1M tokens in the ballpark of $250 — $400 (you mentioned $300 as a target)
- Expected production volumes after pilot: 3–6M tokens/month (mid-case ~4M)
- Budget range for proof-of-concept phase: $8k — $15k total (you said procurement needs a budget number to approve)

Ask / next steps
1) Can Acme confirm whether the 1.2M tokens last week is representative of the team’s expected weekly usage? If there are seasonal spikes we should know.
2) You requested a 3-week extension of pilot credits to validate traffic patterns — I’ve looped in Neha and Rishi to confirm approval flow.
3) I attached the raw usage CSV (acme_pilot_usage.csv) for your internal review. 

Suggested extension (my recommendation)
- Provide a $10,000 credit extension applied to the existing pilot (equivalent to roughly $/1M token coverage depending on model mix; see note below)
- Track to the same SLAs and quota; we’ll do a burn-rate check at the end of the extension and re-evaluate conversion hooks

Unit economics note (illustrative)
- If the team hits ~4M tokens/month and we price at $300 per 1M tokens, monthly cost ~= $1,200 (this is incremental to our hosted metering; enterprise pricing/discounts may apply if committed)
- The $10k credit should cover the next ~25–30 days of pilot consumption at the current burn pattern and model mix; exact coverage depends on model variant (e.g., large-chat vs quantized embedding models)

If that sounds right, Jordan, I’ll request internal approval today and get the credit issued so procurement has the extension in writing.

Thanks —
Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachment: acme_pilot_usage.csv (CSV — 1.1 MB, stub)

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Corp procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 
- The 1.2M tokens last week were pushed by a single team running a heavy ingest job; steady-state weekly looks closer to 0.8–1.0M for the other teams. So your projected ~4M/month mid-case still feels right.
- Procurement would prefer a written credit extension and a single PO for the pilot extension if possible. They asked for a 3-week window and a line-item showing the credit amount.

We’re comfortable with the $10k recommendation as long as there’s a clear end date and a short handoff doc on conversion/levers after the pilot. Can you also confirm whether embeddings are being routed to the quantized model (we saw higher costs on embedding churn last week)?

If you can send the extension paperwork, I’ll push it through procurement and get the PO out.

— Jordan
Director, AI Platform
Acme Corp

Rishi / Neha —

Forwarding the thread with Acme (Jordan) — they’re requesting a 3-week extension and are asking us to apply a $10k credit to their pilot so procurement can issue a PO. Key facts:
- Observed burn: 1.2M tokens last 7 days (ingest spike); steady-state ~3.2–4.0M/month expected
- Customer target: $/1M tokens ~$300 (budget range $250–$400)
- They want an explicit credit line item for 3 weeks so procurement can approve quickly

Recommended internal ask: approve $10,000 credit applied to Acme’s pilot, effective immediately, with a scheduled burn-rate review on 7/8/2026 (three weeks). If they exceed burn materially we’ll pause and re-evaluate and escalate to Sales Ops.

Rationale: covers projected pilot usage at current model mix and shows good faith to convert; limits exposure to 3 weeks. I’ve attached the usage CSV for your review.

Let me know if you need a different amount or additional guardrails (quota caps, model routing to quantized embeddings only, etc.).

Thanks —
Marissa

Attachment: acme_pilot_usage.csv (CSV — stub)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check — approval request

Marissa / Neha —

Approved. Please issue the $10,000 pilot credit to Acme Corp and confirm the following controls are in place before activation:
- Quota cap equal to 1.5x current 7-day burn to limit unexpected spikes (we can set to 1.8M tokens/week for the extension period)
- Routing: enforce embeddings -> quantized-emb model where possible (Neha, please coordinate)
- Extension valid for 21 days from activation; final burn-rate review on 2026-07-08

I’m attaching the signed internal approval (pilot_extension_approval.pdf) for records.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
